say:1:1041548501:1.text: Well, well, look who we have here! Another Mauler warrior!
say:1:1041548501:1.source_cn: 嘿！我看到了谁？又一位蛮血勇士！

say:2:1041548502:1.text: As the proud host of the Warsong Festival, I, Mikola, officially invite you to join the next battle for glory!
say:2:1041548502:1.source_cn: 作为战歌节的裁判，曼卡拉向你发出郑重的邀请——请你来参...

say:4:1041548504:1.text: That's right! The Warsong Festival—a grand celebration of strength and spirit in the Ashen Wastes! It's where legends are forged, and cheers shake the earth!
say:4:1041548504:1.source_cn: 没错，战歌节！在荒角沙漠上举办的、属于蛮血的盛大节日！...

say:5:1041548505:1.text: Surely, you've heard of it? I mean, every Mauler knows about the festival!
say:5:1041548505:1.source_cn: 每个蛮血都应该知道！难道你没有听说过吗？

say:6:1041548506:1.text: Oh, I've heard of it, darling. It's just been so long since I thought about it, I needed a little reminder.
say:6:1041548506:1.source_cn: 不，我只是太久没有听到这个词，确认一下而已。

say:7:1041548507:1.text: Sorry to disappoint, but I'm not interested in reliving those days.
say:7:1041548507:1.source_cn: 抱歉，亲爱的，我对战歌节没兴趣。

say:8:1041548508:1.text: I walked away from the Ashen Wastes years ago. Now I prefer the clink of mugs over the clash of swords.
say:8:1041548508:1.source_cn: 实不相瞒，我已经离开荒角沙漠很多年了，也不准备再回去。

say:9:1041548509:1.text: What am I hearing?! A warrior like you, turning down the Warsong Festival? That's every Mauler's dream!
say:9:1041548509:1.source_cn: 我听到了什么？！像你这样的天生的勇士，居然拒绝了战歌节...

say:10:1041548510:1.text: You have the skills, I can feel it! Maybe you won't take the crown, but you'd make one hell of a contender!
say:10:1041548510:1.source_cn: 凭借你的天赋——曼卡拉有预感——即使不能获得最终的胜利...

say:11:1041548511:1.text: Are you sure you don't want to bask in the crowd's roar, the thrill of the fight, the—
say:11:1041548511:1.source_cn: 真的不来试试吗？战歌节的观众会用最热烈的掌声欢迎你！

say:12:1041548512:1.text: Easy there. I'd rather pursue a peaceful life than chase honor earned through brawls.
say:12:1041548512:1.source_cn: 比起用力量获得的荣誉，我更想过平静的日子。抱歉啦。

say:13:1041548513:1.text: But, if the Warsong Festival needs a sponsor, I might be persuaded to talk business.
say:13:1041548513:1.source_cn: 不过，如果战歌节需要赞助商的话，或许我们可以聊一聊哦。
